decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a  flank extension to the existing dwellinghouse, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristic of number 26 Beech Avenue and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development)  and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeast wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before the development commences details of 2 offstreet parking spaces  shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to provide ground floor bedroom and playroom to existing dwellinghouse.
